Unix Timestamp Converter

Convert Unix epoch timestamps to human dates in UTC and local time, and dates back to timestamps.

UTC–
Local time–
ISO 8601–
Seconds–
Milliseconds–

Values ≥ 1,000,000,000,000 are read as milliseconds, smaller values as seconds.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste a Unix timestamp to see the date in UTC, your local timezone and ISO format.
  2. Or pick a date and time to get its timestamp in seconds and milliseconds.
  3. Seconds and milliseconds are auto-detected by magnitude.
  4. Use the “Use now” button for the current timestamp.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it tell seconds from milliseconds?

Any value of 1,000,000,000,000 or more is treated as milliseconds; smaller values are treated as seconds. This is correct for all real-world dates.

Which timezone is the local time in?

Your browser's timezone. The UTC and ISO 8601 outputs are timezone-independent.

Does it handle dates before 1970?

No — only non-negative timestamps are accepted.
